skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and classify social systems, organizations, management, and managers
Understand and apply decision-making processes and management decisions
Understand and apply planning processes and strategic planning
Understand and apply organizing processes and organizational structures
Understand and apply leadership approaches and motivational techniques
Understand and apply controlling processes and systems
Practice effective communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
Practice effective teamwork and group management skills
Understand and apply ethical and social responsibility in management
Practice decision-making skills to solve problems
Analyze and evaluate management theories and practices
Demonstrate independent learning and adaptability to change
Demonstrate professional responsibility and service spirit
